title: Fabulous trip to Monserrat
text: Our guide Victoria was outstanding!  She was extremely knowledgeable and provided lots of details about Spanish history and Monserrat.  Very sweet and accommodating to our needs
author: Kym_A

title: Boy’s Choir
text: Our guide, Jugo, met us at our hotel and we then took a metro and then a train to Monsterret.  (Given our first time on those, it was nice to have a guide.). Jugó was very friendly and shared a lot of insight.  One thing we didn’t know is that you need to purchase tickets for the boy‘a choir ahead of time as it is typically sold out.  If that is something you’re interested, contact the tour company and let them know.
author: Marie_S

title: Great side trip from Barcelona.
text:
Carlos was amazing! A fantastic day, in a mesmerizing environment. Would recommend for anyone!

Lunch couldn't have been better.
author: David_S

title: Our tour guide was so...
text: Our tour guide was so nice and knowledgeable. She made our trip very easy. Montserrat was beautiful!! I would definitely recommend this tour.
author: trudy_H

title: Great Day!
text: Hugo was a great guide for our day trip to Montserrat! The mountain was beautiful and the history we learned was interesting. Thank you!
author: Heather_D

title: Fantastic Montserrat Excursion
text: We had a terrific day at Montserrat with our guide, Lenise. She navigated the Metro and Renfe for us so easily and got all the tickets we needed at Montserrat! We even got to hear the Boys Choir. Lenise  was wonderful to talk to and so knowledgeable about the area and its history. Her enthusiasm about Montserrat was definitely contagious! Thank you.
author: 329marylynnh

title: A holy place
text:
Great trip and well worth the time it took to get there from Barcelona. Our guide is as so friendly, kind and accommodating our every need. We felt like family when we left her. Our favorite thing was the boys choir in the basilicas, the museum. 
My only comment is that it needs to be one hour longer, felt rushed
author: Christopher_L

title: The views, history, and...
text:
The views, history, and Monastery!
It is a must when visiting Barcelona!!
Mary, our tour guide was very sweet, but I think after she completes her course in Tourism she will be more knowledgeable especially with the history and presentation.
Good luck Mary with your studies!!
Arline and Ron
author: Arline_C

title: Best Excursion
text: LINESE was amazing tour guide!!! She was extremely knowledgable and was with us a the whole time. This is a very different excursion as far as that you are not loaded up on a bus with others, you take the local expierence. The guide will fome to your hotel by foot and you will head to the destination. First you will take the local metro, then a train about an hour out of the city to the cable cae that will take you to the Montersery at the top of the mountain. title: Best time spent outside Barcelona
text: Having someone escort us from our hotel in Barcelona to the Mount. And then seeing the magnitude of Montserrat from the gondola ride to the top.
